title: 第3章 角色卡
content_zh:
第3章角色卡
康阳区治安署调查员？表哥工作的单位，找我的？
张元清心里本能的一凛，正要走到卧室门口偷听，忽然想起了什么，
再把兵哥写给他的信，折叠好，压在窗台的盆栽下面。
这才放心的
玄关传来外婆不答反问的声音：
“你们找他做什么。”
她没有请调查员入内，而是堵在了门口。
“我们需要向他询问一些事，这是我们的证件。”
说话的是个姑娘，嗓音性感。
外婆目光在证件上略作停留，然后皱着眉头让开道路。
张元清适时
为首的调查员穿着黑色正装，搭配白衬衫黑马甲，手里拄着一根乌木手杖，面容清瘦，留着两撇小胡子，大背头梳的一丝不苟。
这股浓浓的英伦风，以及两撇小胡子，让人不自觉的想起民国时代的海归绅士。
海归绅士左边是容貌秀丽的年轻女调查员，五官立体感十足，似乎是个混血，嘴角笑吟吟的，水汪汪的眸子非常灵动。
她身高大概有175cm，拥有堪比超模的大长腿，穿着正装，女士衬衫的下摆塞进裤腰里，勾勒出纤细的腰肢和鼓胀的胸脯，干练精致。
最后那位调查员，表情木讷，戴着黑框眼镜，头发略显凌乱，很有理工狗气质。
“我是张元清，你们找我什么事？”
在张元清审视他们的同时，调查员也在打量这个年轻人。
混血女调查员笑吟吟道：

“我们是康阳区治安署的调查员，有些问题想问你，请配合调查。”
“好的.”
张元清引着他们在客厅沙发坐下，外婆给三位调查员倒了杯水，然后一脸困惑的盯着外孙。
她想不到热情开朗擅长交际，自己一手带大的娃，会因为什么事需要警署调查员上门问询。
头发凌乱，目光呆滞的年轻调查员，掏出小本本和笔，拧开笔帽。
梳着大背头的男人坐在沙发上，双手拄着杖，正色道：
“认识雷一兵吗。”
果然是为兵哥的事来的，来的这么快张元清如实回答道：
“我们是从小玩到大的朋友，为什么突然问这个。”
他心里闪过一个疑惑，表哥是康阳区治安署二队的队长，这三位调查员既然上门走访，肯定查过他的家庭背景。
按理说，知道走访的是治安署里二队队长的家人，大家都是同事，不应该通个气，打个招呼？
混体制的，这点人情世故都不懂？
可表哥那边一点动静都没有，显然是不知道，不然就算不跟着过来，也会打电话知会他一下。
“哦，死党！”
男人轻轻踏了一下铮亮的皮鞋，不疾不徐的说道：
“是这样的，雷一兵失踪了，江南省杭城那边的治安署联络我们，说查到雷一兵在失踪前的上午，有寄出一个包裹，收件人是你。”
他目光幽深如潭的凝视着张元清，仿佛能看穿人心，“有这个事吗。”
张元清露出惊愕茫然的表情：“失踪了？这怎么可能”
做笔录的理工狗开口提醒道：
“你只要回答有，或者没有。”

“有，就在刚才，我收到了一份包裹，但上面没有写寄件人名字，我还疑惑是谁给我寄的包裹。”张元清脸色沉重的点头。
这事儿否认没用，警署既然能查到快递，查看小区监控更不在话下。
大背头男人点点头，问道：
“包裹里是什么东西？希望你如实回答，这对我们来说是非常重要的线索。”
边上的外婆松了口气的同时，又忍不住为雷一兵担忧。
那孩子也算是她看着长大的，虽然搬家多年。
张元清回答道：
“包裹里什么都没有，是空的。”
“空的？”大背头男人眯起了眼睛，他那双仿佛能看透人心的目光审视着张元清。
虽然我说谎了，但黑色卡片不翼而飞，和空的没什么两样，不怕你查.张元清没有闪躲，诚恳的与他对视，说道：
“我间，不信你们可以去看。”
如果兵哥的失踪是他所猜测的那样，他现在肯定要先瞒下来，等表哥下班回家，再说明一切。
这种可能存在风险的事，自然是和自家人商量最稳妥。
大背头男人用眼神示意了一下女下属。
后者笑吟吟的进入房间，俄顷，返回客厅，朝同伴微微颔首。
大背头男人沉吟一下，道：
“方便的话，我们想检查一下你的房间，还有电脑。另外，请把你的手机给我看看。”
检查电脑可以，但请不要手机屏幕，递了过去。
大背头男人接过手机，而女调查员则重新进入房间。
大背头男人单手握着手机，拇指简单划拉几下后，就还给了张元清，然后耐心等待。

半刻钟后，女调查员迈着大长腿出来，这次，她摇了摇头。
大背头男人微微颔首，温和道：
“感谢你的配合，我们不打扰了。”
张元清连忙问道：
“我能问一下雷一兵的情况吗？”
他这既是出于真心，也是为了“圆谎”，听闻发小失踪却不追问情况，那就太可疑了。
大背头男人耐心回答：
“雷一兵在宿舍里失踪了，楼道里的监控没有拍到他离开的画面。根据一名室友提供的信息，那天夜里他起床上厕所时，还看到雷一兵睡在床上。
“可早上起来，人就不见了。24小时后，因为联系不到人，他们的辅导员通知了校方，校方立刻报警。
“更详细的情况，你得打电话咨询当地治安署。”
这和雷叔叔说的一样，看来当地治安署根本没有进展，嗯，也可能是这个家伙不想告诉我.张元清点点头：
“我知道了。”
大背头男人带着两名下属朝防盗门走去，半途停下来，转身说道：
“如果有什么线索，你一定要及时通知我们，千万不要对我们有所隐瞒。”
张元清正要点头，就听他笑容意味深长的说：
“不然，下一个失踪的可能就是你。”
下一个失踪的就是我？
他这话是什么意思，威胁我？不交出黑卡就让我和兵哥一样人间蒸发？
话说回来，那张卡到底怎么回事，凭空就消失……想交也交不出去。
“多谢提醒！”

他回了一个没什么笑意的笑容。
不管怎么样，还是等表哥下班回来再说。
兵哥肯定不愿意卡片落入治安署手里，不然不会把东西寄给他。
再说，作为死党兼发小，他相信兵哥不会坑他。
一旁的外婆脸黑了，冷冰冰道：
“不送。”
这人怎么回事，好端端的咒她外孙。
大背头男人笑了笑，从西装的左兜摸出一张名片，递了过来，“有什么事随时联系我。”
待张元清接过后，他领着两名下属离去。
“阿兵怎么失踪了？唉，我抽空去看看阿兵妈。”等人走后，外婆忧心忡忡的说。
两家以前是邻居，低头不见抬头见了十几年，还是有点情份的。
张元清脸色疲惫的说道：
“外婆，我昨晚没睡好，先回房休息，中午要是没起来，就不用喊我了。
“外公回来的话，你把这事儿跟他说，让他联系一下雷叔叔。”
昨晚陪小姨玩到凌晨两三点，早上旧疾复发惊醒，本身就缺觉，为了寻找兵哥到黑卡，又强行透支脑力。
这会儿累的大脑阵阵发昏。
等外婆点头后，张元清返回房间。
关上门，脚后跟互踩，把鞋子脱掉，一头扎到床上，昏头大睡。
黑色商务车里，李东泽坐在真皮软椅上，手柄镶金的手杖斜靠在椅边，掌心托着高脚杯，摇晃着猩红酒液。
“关雅，刚才在房间里有什么发现？”

他扭头，看向身边座位的混血美人。
关雅慵懒的倚在软椅，两条修长的大腿并拢的严丝合缝，俏脸凝重道：
“有重大发现。”
“说。”李东泽正色道。
后排的理工男也把目光从手机里挪开，看了过来。
关雅语气严肃：
“那小子是个黑丝御姐控，他的学习资料里全是成熟御姐，可他的垃圾桶却那么的干净，这简直不合理。”
“他的社交圈很广泛，什么群都有，但只在游戏群和lsp群活跃，其他群都设置了消息屏蔽.他的房间除了游戏机，没有任何娱乐用品，这小子实际性格有点孤僻……对了，什长，你知道lsp是什么意思吧。”
混血美人笑眯眯的做了撸啊撸的姿势。
两名同伴听的一愣一愣，李东泽连忙抬手打断，怒道：
“哦，我的上帝啊，我真想用靴子狠狠踹你屁股。我在跟你说正事，你说这些乱七八糟的做什么。我跟你说过很多次，不要耍流氓不要说荤段子，你这样的习惯很不好，很不优雅。”
长腿御姐丝毫不惧愤怒的上司，笑道：
“不要这么无趣嘛，适当的玩笑有利于活跃气氛。”
她缓缓收起笑容，道：
“我没在他电脑里发现可疑的东西，但在窗台盆栽下面，找到了雷一兵寄给他的信。雷一兵确实有寄东西给他，不出意外就是角色卡，但不知道是什么职业的。”
李东泽沉默几秒，闭目养神：
“明天你再过来一趟，呵，如果他没失踪的话。”
ps：感谢大家的盟主和白银盟。
content_en:
Chapter 3 Character Card
Investigator from the Kangyang District Public Security Bureau? The company where my cousin works is looking for me?
Zhang Yuanqing instinctively shuddered in his heart, and was about to go to the bedroom door to eavesdrop when he suddenly remembered something.
Then fold the letter that Brother Bing wrote to him and press it under the potted plant on the window sill.
That's why I feel relieved
Grandma's voice came from the entrance without answering the question:
"What are you looking for him for?"
Instead of inviting the investigators in, she blocked the door.
"We need to ask him something, and here's our ID."
The speaker was a girl with a sexy voice.
Grandma’s eyes lingered on the certificate for a moment, then she frowned and moved out of the way.
Zhang Yuanqing just in time
The leading investigator wore a black formal suit, a white shirt and a black vest, and held an ebony cane in his hand. He had a thin face, a mustache, and his hair was combed meticulously.
This strong British style, as well as the two mustaches, make people unconsciously think of the gentleman who returned from overseas during the Republic of China era.
To the left of the returned gentleman is a beautiful young female investigator with three-dimensional facial features. She seems to be of mixed race. She has a smile on her lips and very lively watery eyes.
She is about 175cm tall and has long legs comparable to those of a supermodel. She is wearing a formal suit, with the hem of a women's shirt tucked into the waistband of her trousers, outlining her slender waist and bulging breasts, making her look capable and delicate.
The last investigator had a dull expression, wore black-rimmed glasses, had slightly messy hair, and had the temperament of a scientist dog.
"I'm Zhang Yuanqing, what do you want from me?"
While Zhang Yuanqing was looking at them, the investigator was also looking at the young man.
The mixed-race female investigator smiled and said:
"We are investigators from the Kangyang District Public Security Department. We have some questions to ask you. Please cooperate with the investigation."
"Okay."
Zhang Yuanqing led them to sit down on the sofa in the living room. Grandma poured a glass of water for the three investigators, and then stared at her grandson with a confused look.
She never imagined that a child who was enthusiastic, cheerful, and sociable, and who had been raised by herself, would need a police investigator to come to inquire about something.
The young investigator with messy hair and dull eyes took out a small notebook and pen, and unscrewed the cap of the pen.
The man with a slicked back hair was sitting on the sofa, holding a stick in both hands, and said seriously:
"Do you know Lei Yibing?"
As expected, I came because of Brother Bing. He came so quickly and Zhang Yuanqing answered truthfully:
"We have been friends since childhood, why do you suddenly ask this?"
A doubt flashed through his mind. His cousin was the captain of the Second Team of the Kangyang District Public Security Bureau. Since these three investigators came to visit, they must have checked his family background.
Logically speaking, we know that the person we are visiting is the family of the captain of the second team of the Public Security Department. We are all colleagues, so shouldn't we talk to each other and say hello?
A mixed-system person who doesn’t understand this bit of human nature?
But there was no movement at all from my cousin. It was obvious that he didn't know, otherwise even if he didn't follow him, he would have called him to inform him.
"Oh, BFF!"
The man stepped lightly on his shiny leather shoes and said calmly:
"It's like this. Lei Yibing disappeared. The Public Security Bureau in Hangcheng, Jiangnan Province contacted us and said that they found that Lei Yibing sent a package the morning before he disappeared, and the recipient was you."
He stared at Zhang Yuanqing with eyes as deep as a pool, as if he could see through people's hearts, "Is this a problem?"
Zhang Yuanqing showed a shocked and confused expression: "Missing? How is this possible?"
LiGongGou, who was taking notes, reminded:
"You just answer yes or no."
"Yes, just now, I received a package, but the sender's name was not written on it. I was still wondering who sent the package to me." Zhang Yuanqing nodded with a heavy face.
There is no point in denying this matter. Since the police station can check the express delivery, it is not a problem to check the community surveillance.
The man with the big back nodded and asked:
"What is in the package? I hope you will answer truthfully. This is a very important clue for us."
BesideWhile the grandmother breathed a sigh of relief, she couldn't help but worry about Lei Yibing.
She had watched that child grow up, even though he had moved away many years ago.
Zhang Yuanqing replied:
"There's nothing in the package, it's empty."
"Empty?" The man with the big back squinted his eyes, and looked at Zhang Yuanqing with his eyes that seemed to be able to see through people's hearts.
Although I lied, the black card disappeared and was no different from the empty one. I am not afraid of you checking. Zhang Yuanqing did not dodge, looked at him sincerely and said:
"I mean, if you don't believe me, you can go and see it."
If Brother Bing's disappearance was what he had guessed, he would definitely hide it now and wait until his cousin came home from get off work before explaining everything.
Naturally, it is safest to discuss this kind of potentially risky matter with your own family.
The man with the big back pointed his eyes at the female subordinate.
The latter entered the room with a smile, and after a while, returned to the living room and nodded slightly to his companion.
The big-backed man pondered for a moment and said:
"If it's convenient, we'd like to check your room and computer. Also, please show me your cell phone."
It's okay to check the computer, but please don't use the phone screen. I handed it over.
The man with the big back took the phone and the female investigator re-entered the room.
The man with the big back held the phone in one hand. After a few simple swipes with his thumb, he handed it back to Zhang Yuanqing and waited patiently.
Half a quarter of an hour later, the female investigator came out with long legs. This time, she shook her head.
The man with the big back nodded slightly and said gently:
"Thank you for your cooperation, we won't interrupt."
Zhang Yuanqing asked quickly:
"Can I ask about Lei Yibing's situation?"
He did this out of sincerity, but also to "fulfill his lies." It would be too suspicious to hear that Fa Xiao was missing but didn't inquire about the situation.
The man with the big back answered patiently:
"Lei Yibing disappeared in the dormitory, and the surveillance in the corridor did not capture him leaving. According to information provided by a roommate, when he got up to go to the toilet that night, he saw Lei Yibing sleeping on the bed.
“But when I woke up in the morning, the person was gone. After 24 hours, because they could not contact anyone, their counselor notified the school, who immediately called the police.
"For more detailed information, you have to call the local Sheriff's Department."
This is the same as what Uncle Lei said. It seems that the local public security department has made no progress at all. Well, it may be that this guy doesn't want to tell me. Zhang Yuanqing nodded:
"I understand."
The man with a big back and two subordinates walked towards the security door, stopped halfway, turned around and said:
"If you have any clues, you must inform us in time and don't hide anything from us."
Zhang Yuanqing was about to nod when he heard him say with a meaningful smile:
"Otherwise, you may be the next one to disappear."
Will I be the next one to disappear?
What does he mean by this, threatening me? If you don't hand over the black card, you will let me disappear like Brother Bing?
Speaking of which, what happened to that card? It disappeared out of thin air... I couldn't hand it over even if I wanted to.
"Thanks for the reminder!"
He returned a smile without a smile.
No matter what, let's wait until my cousin comes back from get off work.
Brother Bing definitely doesn't want the card to fall into the hands of the Sheriff's Department, otherwise the items will not be sent to him.
Besides, as his best friend and childhood friend, he believed that Brother Bing would not cheat him.
The grandmother on the side turned dark and said coldly:
"I won't send it."
What's going on with this person? He's so cursed at her grandson.
The bearded man smiled, took out a business card from the left pocket of his suit, and handed it over, "Contact me anytime if you need anything."
After Zhang Yuanqing took it over, he led his two subordinates away.
"Why is A Bing missing? Alas, I took the time to go see A Bing's mother." After the others left, grandma said worriedly.
The two families used to be neighbors. They had seen each other for more than ten years, but they still had some affection for each other.
Zhang Yuanqing said with a tired face:
"Grandma, I didn't sleep well last night, go back to your room to rest first. If you don’t get up at noon, you don’t need to call me.
"When grandpa comes back, tell him about this and ask him to contact Uncle Lei."
I played with my aunt until two or three in the morning last night. In the morning, I was awakened by the recurrence of my old illness. I was sleep deprived. In order to find Brother Bing and get the black card, I forced myself to overuse my brain.
At this moment, my tired brain felt dizzy.
After grandma nodded, Zhang Yuanqing returned to the room.
She closed the door, stepped on her heels, took off her shoes, threw herself on the bed, and fell asleep.
In the black business car, Li Dongze was sitting on a soft leather chair, leaning against the chair with a cane with a gold handle, holding a goblet in his palm, shaking scarlet wine.
"Guan Ya, what did you find in the room just now?"
He turned his head and looked at the mixed-race beauty sitting next to him.
Guan Ya leaned lazily on the soft chair, her two slender thighs tightly together, her pretty face said solemnly:
"A major discovery has been made."
"Say." Li Dongze said seriously.
The man in science and engineering in the back row also looked away from his phone and looked over.
Guan Ya said in a serious tone:
"That boy is a black stockings connoisseur. His study materials are full of mature ladies, but his trash can is so clean. This is simply unreasonable."
"His social circle is very wide, and he is in all kinds of groups, but he is only active in the game group and the lsp group. The other groups have set up message blocking. In addition to the game console, his room does not have any entertainment supplies. This kid's actual personality is a bit withdrawn... By the way, Shichang, you know what lsp means, right?"
The mixed-race beauty smiled and made a stroking gesture.
The two companions were stunned for a moment. Li Dongze quickly raised his hand to interrupt and said angrily:
"Oh, my God, I really want to kick your ass with my boot. I'm telling you business, why are you talking about all this nonsense. I've told you many times, don't be a hooligan and don't tell dirty jokes. This habit of yours is very bad and very inelegant."
The long-legged royal sister was not afraid of the angry boss at all and said with a smile:
"Don't be so boring. Appropriate jokes can help liven up the atmosphere."
She slowly put away her smile and said:
"I didn't find anything suspicious on his computer, but under the potted plant on the window sill, I found a letter sent to him by Lei Yibing. Lei Yibing did send him something. Not surprisingly, it was a character card, but I don't know what occupation it is."
Li Dongze was silent for a few seconds, closed his eyes and rested:
"You can come over again tomorrow, ha, if he hasn't disappeared."
ps: Thank you all for being the leader and the Silver Alliance.
